metadata.description: Shared Claude Code skills and agents for consistent development workflows across projects.

plugins.name: nolte-shared
plugins.description: Shared Claude Code skills and agents for consistent development workflows across projects.

plugins.name: nolte-media
plugins.description: Brand-aware image generation and media processing: provider-pluggable text-to-image, manual Gemini handoff, brand-conformant prompt authoring, and PNG-to-transparent-SVG vectorisation. Requires external image-generation credentials and binaries.

plugins.name: nolte-engineering
plugins.description: Engineering capabilities for code-bearing projects: full-stack implementation, the test-tier and test-cycle suite, the quality gate, frontend/web-UI optimization, and code-security / dependency / license auditing. Code repositories adopt this on top of nolte-shared.

plugins.name: nolte-claude-dev
plugins.description: Claude Code skill and agent authoring for plugin/skill developers: spec-conformant skill/agent scaffolding and revision, skill and agent review, portfolio-wide skills/agents sweeps, and skills/agents documentation-catalog generation. Adopt this on top of nolte-shared only if you author Claude Code skills or agents; the majority of consumers never do.
